[[File:Arneclin_Masterpieces.png|thumb|right|200px|The Arneclin Masterpieces]]
The '''''Arneclin Masterpieces''''' were a set of [[Painting/Legends|paintings]]. The set included paintings of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Kaas City]], an underworld [[Casino/Legends|casino]], the approach of [[Oricon]], [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
